title: Are you in a good or bad mood? 🤩😡 Improve your listening with Real Easy English

sentences.en: Hi Georgie, how are you today?
sentences.ko: 안녕, 조지, 오늘 어때요?

sentences.en: I'm pretty good today, thank you, Neil. How are you?
sentences.ko: 오늘은 꽤 괜찮아요, 고마워요, 닐. 당신은요?

sentences.en: I am much better than I was this morning.
sentences.ko: 오늘 아침보다 훨씬 나아요.

sentences.en: Oh. How were you feeling this morning?
sentences.ko: 오. 오늘 아침엔 기분이 어땠는데요?

sentences.en: I was really grumpy.
sentences.ko: 정말 짜증이 났어요.

sentences.en: Oh! Why is that?
sentences.ko: 오! 왜요?

sentences.en: Well, I'll tell you in a minute, but that's what we're talking about today – being grumpy, which means being in a bad mood.
sentences.ko: 음, 곧 말해 줄게요. 그런데 그게 바로 오늘의 주제예요. grumpy, 즉 기분이 안 좋은 상태요.

sentences.en: Yes, but before we begin, our listeners need to know that they can find a worksheet, a free worksheet, on our website at bbclearningenglish.com.
sentences.ko: 네, 그런데 시작하기 전에, 청취자분들은 웹사이트 bbclearningenglish.com에서 무료 학습지를 받을 수 있다는 걸 알아야 해요.

sentences.en: So, you said you were feeling grumpy this morning.
sentences.ko: 그러니까 오늘 아침에 짜증이 났다고요.

sentences.en: I didn't notice that.
sentences.ko: 전혀 몰랐어요.

sentences.en: Why were you feeling grumpy this morning?
sentences.ko: 오늘 아침에 왜 짜증이 났어요?

sentences.en: I get really grumpy if I'm hungry or tired, and very, very grumpy if I'm hungry and tired.
sentences.ko: 저는 배고프거나 피곤하면 정말 짜증이 나고, 배고프면서 피곤하면 아주아주 짜증이 나요.

sentences.en: Oh no! Is that how you were feeling this morning then?
sentences.ko: 저런! 오늘 아침에 그랬던 거예요?

sentences.en: Yeah. It's very hot at the moment – difficult to sleep.
sentences.ko: 네. 요즘 너무 더워서 잠들기 힘들어요.

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.ko: 그렇죠.

sentences.en: And we also didn't have any food in the fridge, so I came to work hungry and tired, and so I was grumpy.
sentences.ko: 그리고 냉장고에 먹을 것도 없어서, 배고프고 피곤한 채로 출근했어요. 그래서 짜증이 났죠.

sentences.en: Oh well, you hid it very well.
sentences.ko: 아, 정말 잘 숨겼네요.

sentences.en: I didn't notice that.
sentences.ko: 전혀 몰랐어요.

sentences.en: I've felt cheerful all day so far.
sentences.ko: 저는 지금까지 하루 종일 기분이 좋았어요.

sentences.en: Well, you're always cheerful, Georgie.
sentences.ko: 음, 당신은 늘 밝잖아요, 조지.

sentences.en: Or are you?
sentences.ko: 아닌가요?

sentences.en: I... No, I'm not always cheerful.
sentences.ko: 저... 아니요, 늘 밝지는 않아요.

sentences.en: Mostly, I have to say, mostly I am.
sentences.ko: 대부분은, 대부분은 그렇다고 해야겠네요.

sentences.en: But there are certain times of the month that make me feel very grumpy.
sentences.ko: 그런데 한 달 중에 아주 짜증이 나는 때가 있어요.

sentences.en: And when I'm in a bad mood, I become a bit irritable.
sentences.ko: 그리고 기분이 안 좋을 땐 좀 예민해져요.

sentences.en: Small things that other people do annoy me.
sentences.ko: 다른 사람들이 하는 사소한 것에도 짜증이 나요.

sentences.en: And sometimes it's not for any reason or it's for a very small reason and I shouldn't be so grumpy.
sentences.ko: 가끔은 아무 이유 없이, 아니면 아주 사소한 이유로 그래요. 그렇게까지 짜증 낼 필요는 없는데요.

sentences.en: OK. Georgie, what kind of things make you grumpy?
sentences.ko: 그렇군요. 조지, 어떤 것 때문에 짜증이 나요?

sentences.en: Well, as I said, there are certain times of the month where I feel grumpy, but other things that make me grumpy...
sentences.ko: 음, 말했듯이 한 달 중 짜증 나는 때가 있고, 그 밖에 짜증 나게 하는 건...

sentences.en: Usually, if it's a really sunny day outside and I'm stuck inside working, that makes me feel a bit grumpy because I would prefer to be outside in the sun, in the park, spending time in the fresh air, but instead I'm working.
sentences.ko: 보통 밖은 정말 화창한데 저는 안에 갇혀서 일하고 있으면 좀 짜증이 나요. 햇볕 아래 공원에서 신선한 공기를 마시며 시간을 보내고 싶은데, 대신 일을 하고 있으니까요.

sentences.en: So, you said that you're grumpy when you're hungry or tired.
sentences.ko: 그러니까 배고프거나 피곤하면 짜증이 난다고 했죠.

sentences.en: What kind of things do you do to cheer yourself up?
sentences.ko: 기분을 풀려고 어떤 걸 해요?

sentences.en: Ah yeah, 'to cheer myself up' – to feel better.
sentences.ko: 아 네, 'to cheer myself up', 기분이 나아지게 하는 거죠.

sentences.en: Well, eat something and sleep.
sentences.ko: 음, 뭘 먹고 자요.

sentences.en: But I guess also do something relaxing.
sentences.ko: 그리고 뭔가 편안한 걸 하는 것 같아요.

sentences.en: Maybe do some exercise.
sentences.ko: 운동을 하기도 하고요.

sentences.en: Exercise is a really good thing to lift your mood.
sentences.ko: 운동은 기분을 끌어올리는 데 정말 좋아요.

sentences.en: Yes. I, as I said, like to be outside.
sentences.ko: 네. 저는 말했듯이 밖에 있는 걸 좋아해요.

sentences.en: That will make me...
sentences.ko: 그러면 저는...

sentences.en: That will put me in a better mood.
sentences.ko: 그러면 기분이 나아져요.

sentences.en: Going for a walk in the park, being in nature with some fresh air.
sentences.ko: 공원 산책, 신선한 공기 속에서 자연과 함께하는 거요.

sentences.en: I also really like to put some upbeat music on and dance around my bedroom.
sentences.ko: 그리고 신나는 음악을 틀고 방에서 춤추는 것도 정말 좋아해요.

sentences.en: I like doing that.
sentences.ko: 그거 좋아해요.

sentences.en: That cheers me up.
sentences.ko: 그러면 기분이 좋아져요.

sentences.en: OK. I think that would cheer everybody up.
sentences.ko: 좋아요. 그건 모두의 기분을 좋게 할 것 같은데요.

sentences.en: What? If they got to watch it?
sentences.ko: 뭐라고요? 그걸 구경할 수 있으면요?

sentences.en: Yeah!
sentences.ko: 네!

sentences.en: What do you think about people who are always grumpy?
sentences.ko: 늘 짜증 내는 사람들에 대해선 어떻게 생각해요?

sentences.en: I do know someone who's always grumpy, but he's so grumpy, it's almost funny.
sentences.ko: 늘 투덜대는 사람을 한 명 알아요. 그런데 너무 투덜대서 거의 웃길 정도예요.

sentences.en: Yeah?
sentences.ko: 그래요?

sentences.en: Like, he knows he's grumpy.
sentences.ko: 그러니까, 본인도 자기가 투덜이인 걸 알아요.

sentences.en: And people make little jokes about it and he, kind of, knows he's grumpy.
sentences.ko: 사람들이 그걸로 살짝 농담도 하고, 본인도 좀 알고 있어요.

sentences.en: Mmm. So, it's entertaining for you.
sentences.ko: 음. 그러니까 당신한텐 재밌는 거네요.

sentences.en: Yeah. But it's still not really that nice to be close to.
sentences.ko: 네. 그래도 가까이 있기에 그렇게 기분 좋진 않아요.

sentences.en: Yeah. A bit of a negative energy.
sentences.ko: 네. 좀 부정적인 에너지죠.

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.ko: 맞아요.

sentences.en: Georgie are you good at hiding it when you are grumpy?
sentences.ko: 조지, 짜증 날 때 잘 숨기는 편이에요?

sentences.en: Well, apparently I am, because I sometimes am grumpy and you said that I never seem grumpy, so maybe I am very good at hiding it.
sentences.ko: 음, 그런 것 같아요. 가끔 짜증이 나는데 당신은 제가 짜증 나 보인 적이 없다고 했으니까, 아마 아주 잘 숨기나 봐요.

sentences.en: I think it's good not to let other people feel your negativity coming out of you, but on the other hand I think it's also good to share how you feel sometimes.
sentences.ko: 다른 사람들이 내 부정적인 기분을 느끼지 않게 하는 건 좋다고 생각해요. 하지만 한편으로는 가끔 내 기분을 나누는 것도 좋다고 생각해요.

sentences.en: OK. So, perhaps you are really grumpy right now...
sentences.ko: 그렇군요. 그러니까 어쩌면 지금 정말 짜증이 나 있는데...

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.ko: 네.

sentences.en: ...even though you seem cheerful.
sentences.ko: ...밝아 보이는 걸 수도 있겠네요.

sentences.en: Even though I have a big smile on my face, yeah.
sentences.ko: 얼굴에 큰 미소를 짓고 있는데도요, 네.

sentences.en: It's because I've had a coffee.
sentences.ko: 커피를 마셔서 그래요.

sentences.en: I'm feeling good.
sentences.ko: 기분 좋아요.

sentences.en: OK. Georgie, it's time now to recap the language that we've used in this podcast.
sentences.ko: 좋아요. 조지, 이제 이번 팟캐스트에서 쓴 표현을 정리할 시간이에요.

sentences.en: Yes, we had 'grumpy', which means easily annoyed, negative or in a bad mood.
sentences.ko: 네, 'grumpy'가 나왔어요. 쉽게 짜증 내거나, 부정적이거나, 기분이 안 좋다는 뜻이에요.

sentences.en: Yes, 'in a bad mood'.
sentences.ko: 네, 'in a bad mood'요.

sentences.en: And the opposite of that is 'in a good mood', when you're feeling happy and cheerful.
sentences.ko: 그 반대는 'in a good mood'예요. 행복하고 밝은 기분일 때요.

sentences.en: 'Cheerful' is another word we heard today.
sentences.ko: 'Cheerful'도 오늘 나온 단어예요.

sentences.en: Yes, 'cheerful' is another word for happy, but you show it in an obvious way, maybe by smiling.
sentences.ko: 네, 'cheerful'은 행복하다는 뜻인데, 웃는 것처럼 겉으로 확실히 드러나는 거예요.

sentences.en: Yep. And we've got the phrasal verb 'cheer up', which means to become happy or cheerful.
sentences.ko: 네. 그리고 구동사 'cheer up'은 행복해지거나 밝아진다는 뜻이에요.

sentences.en: Yes. For example, I cheer myself up by dancing alone in my bedroom.
sentences.ko: 네. 예를 들어 저는 방에서 혼자 춤추면서 기분을 풀어요.

sentences.en: That's it for this episode of Real Easy English, but come back next week for another episode.
sentences.ko: Real Easy English 이번 에피소드는 여기까지예요. 다음 주에 다른 에피소드로 다시 만나요.

sentences.en: Yes. And don't forget, you can find a free transcript and worksheet to practise what you've learnt on our website, bbclearningenglish.com.
sentences.ko: 네. 그리고 잊지 마세요, 웹사이트 bbclearningenglish.com에서 배운 걸 연습할 수 있는 무료 대본과 학습지를 볼 수 있어요.

sentences.en: Goodbye for now.
sentences.ko: 오늘은 여기까지, 안녕히.

sentences.en: Goodbye.
sentences.ko: 안녕.
